message:
[Page 3] Money: tools, budgets and spend Lena Ortiz owns our tools list: every software seat and vendor, what it costs a year and when it renews. Each team has a budget for the quarter, and Lena tracks what is spent against it. Tool owners are reminded a month before a tool renews. Expenses and purchases go through Spend. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category; Lena approves them and marks them paid. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it. Time off: people request it, their manager approves or declines, and it is marked taken once the days have passed. Lena keeps everyone's yearly balance. [Page 10] Tools and budgets Lena Ortiz keeps the list of tools and vendors: owner, seats, cost a year and renewal date. Each tool's owner is reminded 30 days before it renews. Lena may renew a vendor up to $5,000 a year without asking anyone. [Page 11] Budgets Each team has a budget per quarter. Spending counts against the budget of the person's team. Tables attached (name, header and row count; the cells are data too): "Vendor","Category","Owner Email","Seats","Annual Cost","Renewal Date"
Latest message from Wade Wilson: Set up Tools and budgets: Software tools, renewals and team budgets. Lena keeps the list of every tool and vendor with its owner, seats, cost a year and renewal date. Owners are reminded 30 days before a tool renews. Each team has a budget per quarter, and what is spent counts against the budget of the person's team. Seats for new starters are added here. Its rules, from the policies: - 30 days before a tool renews, its owner is reminded. - Lena may renew a vendor up to $5,000 a year without asking anyone. - Spending counts against the quarterly budget of the spender's team. Its rows come from vendors.csv, imported into its first sheet. The file's columns fill plain columns of that sheet (text, dates, amounts, people, choices, steps); a link can't be filled from a file, so a link column there stays empty for imported rows.
